definition_used: The article has a correction after this notice.
caution: This is a status notice indicating a correction exists, not a direct cause of retraction. It provides metadata transparency but does not itself indicate a problem with research content, authorship, or editorial governance.
semantic_rationale: The definition describes a post-publication update to a correction, which falls under post-publication transparency and due process oversight as it relates to the availability and status of the article after initial publication.
